response.rationale: Reach exhibits an extreme positive deviation (z=11.5), clearly triggering a mechanical surge. CPM is unflagged (-1.87), indicating the volume expansion is not accompanied by cost inflation typical of aggressive bidding changes. Own-action confound is false, ruling out self-referential feedback loops. The combination points to a genuine external demand or inventory shift driving the reach spike. Magnitude capped at 10.0 given the >10 standard deviation excursion.
